const r = await tools.exec_command({
  cmd: "set -euo pipefail
pack_root='evidence/quality/repair-window-49-20260928/orchestration'
while IFS=$'\t' read -r src rel expected; do
  dst="$pack_root/$rel"
  if [ -e "$dst" ]; then
    cmp -s -- "$src" "$dst" || { echo "CONFLICT $dst" >&2; exit 3; }
  else
    mkdir -p -- "${dst%/*}"
    cp -- "$src" "$dst"
  fi
  actual=$(sha256sum -- "$dst")
  actual=${actual%% *}
  [ "$actual" = "$expected" ] || { echo "SHA_MISMATCH $dst" >&2; exit 4; }
done < <(jq -r '.files[] | [.source,.relative_destination,.sha256] | @tsv' .ai/task/repair-w49-20260928/PACK-MANIFEST.json)
cp -- .ai/task/repair-w49-20260928/PACK-MANIFEST.json evidence/quality/repair-window-49-20260928/orchestration-pack-manifest.json
catalog_root='.artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window49-20260928-candidate-catalog'
while IFS= read -r src; do
  rel=${src#"$catalog_root/"}
  mkdir -p -- "${rel%/*}"
  cp -- "$src" "$rel"
done < <(find "$catalog_root" -type f -print | sort)
mkdir -p -- evidence/production-review-v2-lite/migrations
cp -- .artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window49-20260928-migration.json evidence/production-review-v2-lite/migrations/aec182045f0c9c3e6239285d1f3c5fa7b2ddef316ab34bff2af0bfad9a2fe851.json
pub='evidence/quality/repair-window-49-20260928/publication'

for src in .ai/task/repair-w49-20260928/ADJUDICATION-*.json; do cp -- "$src" "$pub/${src##*/}"; done

from pathlib import Path

    assert len(hits)==1,(prefix,hits)

const r = await tools.exec_command({
  cmd: "set -euo pipefail
python3 -c '
import pathlib,re
root=pathlib.Path(".").resolve()
for rel in ["evidence/quality/repair-window-49-20260928/PUBLICATION.md","handoff.md"]:
 p=(root/rel)
 text=p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
 checked=0
 for target in re.findall(r"\[[^]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)",text):
  target=target.split("#",1)[0]
  if not target or "://" in target or target.startswith("mailto:"): continue
  q=(p.parent/target).resolve()
  assert q.exists(),(rel,target)
  checked+=1
 print(f"links_ok {rel} {checked}")
'
